caption: The video captures an elevated city skyline under a low sun, with a broad water surface covered by flat fog stretching across the horizon. Silhouetted skyscrapers cluster on the right, while lower buildings and rooftops occupy the foreground beneath a sky filled with wispy streaks and a bright cloud mass. Near the center, a narrow plume of smoke or steam rises from a point near the horizon and remains visible throughout the scene. The plume appears to move upward, and its upper section continues to billow. As the plume rises, its top bends and leans toward the right, while its lower column stays comparatively straight above the emission point. The buildings, fog layer, horizon, and sun remain largely fixed in the scene, giving no clear sign of panning, tilting, or zooming. The clouds show little discernible drift, so the most evident change is the slow deformation and rightward lean of the rising plume.
relations: A fixed emission point near the horizon continuously releases a narrow vertical plume of smoke.
As the plume rises, its upper section progressively bends and leans toward the right.
The surrounding city skyline, flat fog layer, and low sun remain completely stationary.
